# Codex Adversarial Review

Target: branch diff against f89520331ea3ccf26b6e85fc48b8d3fd55b813d5
Verdict: approve

CORROBORATED-WITH-CAVEATS — not-refuted. The bounded correction is positively demonstrated; no material in-scope defect supports blocking it.

Identity and scope: all four supplied SHA-256 hashes match the working tree and d2280608 byte-for-byte. Read the complete f8952033..d2280608 diff. AST comparison confirms ownership.py changes executable behavior only in _windows_directory_error; the remaining changes are tests, documentation, commentary, and the handoff.

Correctness: ownership.py:1045–1053 reads ctypes.get_last_error() only when no explicit code exists. The installed Python 3.13.15 ctypes source confirms WinError(None) calls live GetLastError; CPython’s implementation confirms use_last_error swaps the callee result into ctypes’ private slot. The selected API is correct. [Python ctypes documentation](https://docs.python.org/3.13/library/ctypes.html#ctypes.get_last_error). The RtlNtStatusToDosError arm at ownership.py:1091 still supplies an explicit code; a local control observed WinError(5) without calling get_last_error.

Reran: requested scoped command reported ‘Ran 200 tests in 0.210s’ and ‘FAILED (errors=168, skipped=4)’, with writable-tempdir refusals preventing full verification. Separately, TestWindowsDirectoryBarrier reported ‘Ran 12 tests in 0.003s — OK’. Replayed archived W08 in memory without editing files: ‘Ran 1 test; failures=3, errors=0, skipped=0’. Each failure arm reported ‘Expected: mock(32) / Actual: mock(None)’. Thus the patched boundary does not mask deletion of the correction.

Audited, not reran: postfix-mutation-evidence.zip and summary-v5.json agree. The prior manifest matches the baseline archive; all 43 existing edits/selectors remain unchanged, with only W08 added. Independently recomputed all 44 mutation byte sequences and checked 88 provenance/result/stderr records: 44 passing unskipped baselines, 44 assertion-failing mutants, and 44 restoration digests matching original/current bytes. Runner, manifest, source and summary bindings agree. The separate round12-fix-mutation-witness.log records the same three RED failures and 12-test GREEN restoration.

Documentation: content.md:305 and :316 agree with unown.py:354 and all four call sites. Tests pin fresh refusal to 1 (test_content_unown.py:2787), and recovery refusals to 2 (:2825, :2856, :3186).

Weakest point: postfix-ci-result.json records run 33981617383 at d2280608f1a77a39ed54ad16f1183e56bdab4fd5 with both Ubuntu and Windows completed/success. The Windows log confirms checkout SHA and reports ‘✓ Test’ (:552), but contains no native-class/method names or skip counts. Native execution is supported indirectly by discovery and the Windows-only decorator, not directly demonstrated by this log. Live GitHub verification was unavailable, and native Windows execution could not be repeated locally. The accepted baseline and disclosed exclusions remain undisturbed.

No material findings.

Next steps:
- Retain verbose Windows output naming the native regression test and its unskipped result to close the remaining evidence caveat.

Persona: spec-reviewer. Why: independently CONFIRM that the bounded post-round-12 correction to OBPI-0.35.0-04 is correct and that its refreshed evidence is real. This is CORRECTION VERIFICATION against an accepted baseline, not a new protocol investigation. Read-only: do not edit source, tests, brief, ledger, locks or markers; do not launch pipelines or delegate implementation.

ACCEPTED BASELINE (do not re-litigate): round 12 at commit f8952033 returned not-refuted from two reviews (Codex receipt arb-step-codexadversary-1e432720be4046cfaee3197e27a82a1a; Claude receipt arb-step-claudeacceptance-3eae42a1cd9845d2900a25e28b595617). Its findings were one medium, two low, one cosmetic. The operator accepted the bounded correction as the direction. The malformed-metadata low is DISCLOSED by ruling and stays out of scope; ledger exceptions #952/#953 are unchanged and out of scope; the brief's Threat Model boundary stands.

SUBJECT: the single correction commit d2280608 (git diff f8952033..d2280608). Acceptance identities now: unown.py 0128624028d2f5f7cce805b17c26a07f1a5b739bf18d035803b6a3a82d2328e1 (unchanged); test_content_unown.py 28176d3795861007ff28a8581043b1256acbc4a7feadedd662546d4be01c13c7 (unchanged); ownership.py d9561d7f0df0ef195767f379f424be2ab1f10ca9a793dda5b781940edff4c091; test_ownership.py 0eae3cbd04fcb9f7a95719e28dce61db0e7580cbfa9cc7ba03ac4260680e2be1. Verify these against the working tree first.

WHAT THE CORRECTION CLAIMS: (1) medium fixed — _windows_directory_error in src/gzkit/content/ownership.py now reads ctypes.get_last_error() when no explicit code is passed, because kernel32 is bound with use_last_error=True and a bare WinError() reads the live pre-call GetLastError; a stale/zero code maps to EINVAL which is in BARRIER_UNSUPPORTED_ERRNOS and would misroute a transient fault to the "unsupported" remedy. Preservation and exit-2 non-success were never affected. (2) tests/content/test_ownership.py: the shared mocked boundary _native_fault_boundary now parks code 32 in a patched ctypes.get_last_error and records WinError calls; test_native_failures_report_the_callee_error_code_not_a_stale_read asserts all three failure arms hand WinError 32, never None. A deterministic NATIVE test test_native_open_failure_reports_the_callee_error_code (skipUnless nt) forces the live slot to 0 via SetLastError then opens a missing nested directory and asserts winerror 3 / errno ENOENT / not in BARRIER_UNSUPPORTED_ERRNOS. (3) docs/user/manpages/content.md exit table: the fresh-path foreign-snapshot refusal is exit 1 (journal_retained=False, _refuse_foreign_declaration_snapshot), the three recovery-side snapshots are exit 2. (4) comment above _OWNERSHIP_EVENT_TYPES names the roster instead of a count.

REFRESHED EVIDENCE TO AUDIT, NOT TRUST (all under docs/design/adr/pre-release/ADR-0.35.0-canon-entry-corpus-landing/appendices/obpi-04-recovery-2026-09-05/final/): summary-v5.json and postfix-mutation-evidence.zip (44-case sweep at source_commit d2280608: the 43 round-12 cases rebound to the new hashes by rebind_manifest44.py with no edit or selector changed, plus ONE new mocked control W08 that deletes the saved-last-error read; check the manifest diff, per-case provenance, W08 mutant stderr, exact restoration); postfix-ci-result.json and postfix-ci-windows.log (GitHub Actions run 33981617383 on ubuntu-latest and windows-latest at d2280608; confirm the head SHA and both conclusions, and whether the Windows log evidences the native test class ran rather than skipped); round12-fix-mutation-witness.log (the RED/GREEN deletion witness). Distinguish what you reran from what you audited.

WHAT TO DO: verify the four hashes; read the diff f8952033..d2280608 in full; run the scoped modules with ./.venv/bin/python -B -m unittest tests.content.test_ownership tests.commands.test_content_unown (uv run cannot initialise its cache in the sandbox; a writable-tempdir refusal is a limitation, not a defect); trace ctypes semantics for use_last_error/get_last_error/WinError from the stdlib in .venv and confirm the fix is the correct API, including that the RtlNtStatusToDosError arm still passes an explicit code; confirm the mocked boundary change cannot mask a regression (it patches get_last_error, so a production that ignores it must fail the new test — show the mutant evidence in the zip); check the manpage rows agree with the exit_code = 2 if journal_retained else 1 contract and the per-site test pins; confirm nothing else in the diff changed behaviour.

RETURN: CORROBORATED | CORROBORATED-WITH-CAVEATS | NOT-CORROBORATED plus the enum not-refuted | refuted. Pass requires the correction positively demonstrated and no in-scope critical/high defect in the correction. Every finding must cite severity, file:line and a concrete reproduction; do not report speculation as an observed failure, and do not reopen the accepted baseline, the disclosed malformed-metadata low, or the ledger exceptions. Include what could NOT be confirmed and a Weakest point section. Show observed command output.
